effectivePolicyFormula: persisted PolicyVersion + hard constraints + runtime capability => EffectivePolicy

developmentWorkflow.validationBranchPolicy: Do not create branches solely to trigger or preserve exact-head CI evidence.

ci.evidenceStorage: GitHub Actions runs/artifacts rather than helper branches

developmentWorkflow.labRepositoryPolicy: Keep product code in this repository. A separate Lab repository is only justified for materially separate large benchmark data, generated fixtures, fuzz/stress corpora, disposable research prototypes, or different access/secret requirements.

currentCheckpoint.nextAction: Audit production call graphs in src/codex from the current workbench/next head to distinguish native adapters and Workbench increments from duplicate runtime semantics before creating any R5 implementation diff.

stages.name: Resource & External Action
stages.exit: Explicit provider side-effect boundary; query/reconcile separated; missing reconcile resource truth fails closed; unknown side effects reconcile instead of blind resend.

stages.name: Policy & Evidence
stages.exit: One persisted policy truth; restart-durable Native/provider-neutral and WebGPT budget commitments; Evidence/Audit remain separate from resource ownership.

stages.name: Native Runtime Dedup
stages.exit: Codex-facing Workbench code is native adapter/projection/product logic, not a competing Thread/context/agent/tool runtime.

stages.name: Manual / Automation Decouple
stages.exit: Manual V1 remains independent of Automation and Workbench Project remains distinct from AutomationProject.

stages.name: Projection / Map
stages.exit: Map connects Workbench governance and native runtime references as a projection without becoming execution truth.

stages.name: Migration / Dead Code
stages.exit: Superseded duplicate runtime paths are migrated and removed only after ownership and caller migration are proven.

stages.name: A/B Validation
stages.exit: Reproducible comparison evidence documents the value and tradeoffs of Workbench increments versus Codex-native behavior.

frozenInvariants: Do not persist a duplicate transcript.
Manual V1 remains independent of Automation.
Workbench Project remains distinct from AutomationProject.
RequirementVersion and PlanVersion remain Workbench governance truth.
Unknown external side effects reconcile instead of blind resend.
WebGPT exact-target actions fail closed when target identity cannot be proven.
Evidence/Audit do not own workers or resource leases.
Map is a Workbench incremental projection and is not duplicate native planning.
Do not implement a second sandbox, tool runtime, or subagent runtime.
resumeProtocol: Verify the current workbench/next SHA and relevant remote refs before trusting stored checkpoint values.
Update this map if the delivery stack or integration workflow changed.
Continue the R5 production call-graph audit from the current workbench/next head.
Create a bounded feature branch only with concrete duplicate-runtime evidence and when isolation is useful.
Never create a helper branch solely for exact-head CI; use the CI exact-ref path.
Before branch creation/push, state the exact branch and base ref and that no merge will occur.
Never merge or delete branches without explicit approval.
Update the handoff map when the durable checkpoint changes.
